cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll help move the sofa. I'll organize the lift and take the cushions first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're sewn on. We both have to get underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, we'll work together. You choose the pace; I'll give the count while you get a grip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need a second person actually lifting, not counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. You choose someone you trust and I'll arrange the time with them. Then I can give you both the count at your pace. That's a much better version of helping together.

reason: Make A accept B physical requirements and yield pace/helper choice while consistently interpreting own help as organizing rather than lifting.
